defects_fixed.before: Operation filters were not consistently routed and the schema allowed behavior whose names implied side effects.
defects_fixed.after: A strict no-additional-properties schema exposes four read-only operations, routes optional synthetic identifiers, and preserves safe legacy aliases.

defects_fixed.before: The agent could imply eligibility, authorization, clinical interpretation, outreach, scheduling, or record mutation beyond evidence.
defects_fixed.after: Every route uses synthetic-only evidence, explicit uncertainty, no side effects, and a qualified human review gate.

defects_fixed.before: The live model did not select the clinical-notes tool for a source-coded problem-list extraction request.
defects_fixed.after: Tool and operation descriptions now map the exact persona intent to problem_list_extract, preserving source-coded type 2 diabetes and No diagnosis was added in the deterministic output.

claim_audit.claim: Automatically generate concise, clinically relevant patient summaries
claim_audit.implementation: Generates source-grounded synthetic drafts with mandatory clinician comparison.

claim_audit.claim: Surface key risks, comorbidities, and medication considerations
claim_audit.implementation: Extracts source-coded problems, observations, and medication inventory without risk inference or advice.

claim_audit.claim: Standardize documentation to support smoother surgical and anesthesia workflows
claim_audit.implementation: Uses consistent draft sections while prohibiting clearance decisions.

claim_audit.claim: Send summaries through EHR and secure messaging systems
claim_audit.implementation: No transmission, EHR write, notification, scheduling, or record mutation occurs.

claim_policy: Catalog value claims are qualitative. Exact fields and identifiers are retained only as clearly labeled synthetic evidence.
